title: European Photonics Roadmap: Integrated Photonics for Edge Computing
text: Photonic integrated circuits and optical interconnects are strategic for energy-efficient edge computing and edge AI inference. The roadmap prioritises low-power on-chip optical links, micro-ring modulators, and silicon photonics to reduce inter-chip energy per bit in data centres and accelerators.

title: EU Hydrogen Strategy for a Climate-Neutral Europe
text: Renewable hydrogen and electrolysers are central to decarbonising industry and transport. The strategy targets green hydrogen production, fuel cells, and electrification to cut emissions across energy-intensive sectors.

title: Regulation on Artificial Intelligence (AI Act)
text: Harmonised rules for trustworthy artificial intelligence and machine learning systems, including risk classification, data governance, and transparency obligations for high-risk AI applications.

title: European Chips Act: Semiconductor Sovereignty
text: Strengthening semiconductor and microelectronics manufacturing capacity in Europe, including advanced packaging, photonics, and pilot lines for next-generation chips and accelerators.

title: Standard for Optical Communication Interfaces
text: Specifies interoperability requirements for optical communication interfaces and on-chip optical links, including modulator signalling and waveguide coupling for high-bandwidth interconnects.
